answers.answer: Shuffle 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards into the initial draw deck. Put 6 Heat cards face up in the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
answers.evidence: Setup 4–8: 'Shuffle your 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards'; 'Place 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine'; 'Set Gear pawn to 1st gear'; 'Draw 7 cards'.

answers.answer: A shift from 1st to 3rd is permitted and costs 1 Heat. Permission to remain in the same gear is unsupported: the summary says to move up or down one position. The cost belongs to Shift Gears and the Heat cycle indicates Engine to discard, but the precise timing of payment during that step is unsupported.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: 'Move your Gear pawn up or down one position. Shifting two positions costs 1 Heat.' Player Reference explicitly gives '1st to 3rd'. Heat Card Cycle: 'Heat moves from Engine to discard'.

answers.answer: No. In 3rd gear with enough playable cards you must commit 3 cards, face down.
answers.evidence: Play Cards: 'Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number'; '3rd = 3'.

answers.answer: Steps 1–2 happen simultaneously; steps 3–9 follow in the sequential phase, front car first. The summary does not explicitly establish whether each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next begins, or which side-by-side car acts first.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure labels 'Simultaneous Phase (Steps 1-2)' and 'Sequential Phase (Steps 3-9, front car first)'.

answers.answer: Cars do not block passage. If the destination space is full, use the first free spot behind the blocking cars. Prefer the spot closest to the Race Line when available.
answers.evidence: Blocked Movement: 'Cars never block passage' and 'first free spot behind the blocking cars'. Reveal & Move: 'spot closest to the Race Line if available'.

answers.answer: Continue flipping past the Heat and Starting Upgrade until the Speed 3 appears; it gives the Stress card a value of 3. The destinations of the flipped Heat, Upgrade, and Speed cards and the played Stress card during this resolution are unsupported. Stress must supply its value for Reveal & Move, which precedes Adrenaline; the general end-of-turn rule moves Play Area cards to discard, but the summary does not explicitly locate these particular flipped cards in that area.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: 'flip cards from your draw deck until a Speed card appears; that card replaces the Stress card’s value'. Turn Structure lists Reveal & Move at 3 and Adrenaline at 4. Replenish Hand: 'Move Play Area cards to discard pile'.

answers.answer: The last two cars receive the option to add 1 speed and gain 1 extra Cooldown in a five-car race. The listed sequence puts Adrenaline before React, where Boost occurs; permission to take the extra movement after Boost is unsupported. Saving unused Adrenaline for another round is also unsupported.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: 'Last car (or last 2 in 5+ player races) may add 1 extra speed and gain 1 extra Cooldown.' Step 4 precedes step 5, 'React — Activate Cooldown and/or Boost symbols'.

answers.answer: 2nd gear allows Cooldown 1, so you can move the Heat card from hand to Engine during React. Boost costs 1 Heat. Whether you may order Cooldown before Boost and immediately spend that same card is unsupported: the summary allows both actions but gives no within-React ordering rule.
answers.evidence: Cooldown: 'Move Heat cards from your hand back to your Engine' and '2nd gear (Cooldown 1)'. React: 'Activate Cooldown and/or Boost symbols'. Boost: 'Pay 1 Heat'.

answers.answer: You may Boost once per turn by paying 1 Heat. An empty Engine cannot supply that payment, so you cannot Boost while it remains empty. Flip from the draw deck until a Speed card appears and move by its value. That added speed counts for corner checks.
answers.evidence: Boost: 'Pay 1 Heat to flip cards from your draw deck until you reveal a Speed card; move your car accordingly. Once per turn. Increases speed for corner checks.' Heat cycle begins 'Engine to discard'.

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. Check speed 6, excluding the two Slipstream spaces. Against limit 4, pay 2 Heat if you have enough.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: 'optionally move 2 spaces forward (does NOT count toward corner speed check)'. Check Corner: 'pay Heat equal to the difference between your speed and the corner’s Speed Limit'.

answers.answer: The summary does not establish how multiple crossed corners are checked or their order, so the required total is unsupported. Its per-corner formula would give 2 Heat for limit 6 and 4 Heat for limit 4 at speed 8; if both are checked, those amounts sum to 6, but the summary does not establish that condition.
answers.evidence: Check Corner only says 'If you crossed a Corner Line, pay Heat equal to the difference between your speed and the corner’s Speed Limit (if exceeded)'.

answers.answer: You owe 3 Heat but have only 2, so spin out. Pay both remaining Heat, which the Heat cycle places into discard. Move back to the first free space before the corner, take 2 Stress because you were in 4th gear, and set your gear to 1st. The destination zone for the new Stress cards is unsupported.
answers.evidence: Spin Out: 'pay all remaining Heat', 'first free space before the corner', '2 Stress (3rd/4th gear)', 'move Gear pawn to 1st gear'. Heat Card Cycle: 'Engine to discard'.

answers.answer: You may voluntarily discard unwanted Speed cards from hand during Discard. You may not discard Stress or Heat cards. Whether you may browse either player's discard pile and what pile information is public are unsupported.
answers.evidence: Discard: 'Optionally discard cards from hand (never Stress or Heat cards)'. No discard-pile visibility rule is supplied.

answers.answer: Move the cards in your Play Area to the discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand to 7.
answers.evidence: Replenish Hand: 'Move Play Area cards to discard pile, draw back up to 7 cards'.

answers.answer: Immediately shuffle the discard pile into a new draw deck, excluding Play Area cards. Continue the Stress flips until a Speed card appears; the immediate reshuffle and the Stress stopping condition together establish this continuation.
answers.evidence: Running Out of Cards: 'Shuffle discard pile into a new draw deck immediately (do not include Play Area cards)'. Stress: 'flip cards from your draw deck until a Speed card appears'.

answers.answer: Paid Heat moves from Engine to discard. It later cycles into the draw deck and hand, and Cooldown returns it from hand to Engine. You may not normally play Heat or voluntarily discard it from hand.
answers.evidence: Heat Card Cycle: 'Heat moves from Engine to discard to draw deck to hand; only returns to Engine via Cooldown'. 'Heat cards can never be discarded or played from hand.'

answers.answer: Commit the two playable cards and cover the remaining two required cards with Heat. Your car moves 0 spaces. Set your gear to 1st and skip directly to step 9, so you cannot use React to cool Heat that turn. At step 9, Play Area cards go to discard; the summary gives no separate destination or handling rule for the Heat used to cover the commitment and does not explicitly say whether those covering Heat cards enter the Play Area.
answers.evidence: Cluttered Hand: 'play what you can, cover the rest with Heat cards. Your car does not move; move Gear to 1st gear, skip to step 9.' Replenish Hand moves Play Area cards to discard.

answers.answer: Crossing first does not automatically decide a same-round finish: the car furthest ahead wins, with the car closest to the Race Line winning a side-by-side tie. Finished cars are placed in order on the Hall of Fame, but the precise timing of their removal from the track is unsupported.
answers.evidence: Victory Conditions: 'If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins (closest to Race Line breaks ties)' and 'Continue playing until all cars finish; place finished cars in order on the Hall of Fame'.

answers.answer: The restriction applies after crossing the final finish line, so a qualifying Slipstream can take you across it. Once normal movement has already crossed it, you may not Slipstream afterward. Ignore corner speed limits beyond that final finish line.
answers.evidence: Slipstream permits an optional 2-space move when eligible. Victory Conditions: 'After crossing the finish line on the final lap: no slipstreaming allowed; ignore speed limits after the finish line'.

answers.answer: Unsupported. The summary says the last two cars get Adrenaline in 5+ player races, but does not establish whether that threshold uses the starting car count or only cars still racing after finishes. Therefore it does not resolve whether one or both remaining cars receive it.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: 'Last car (or last 2 in 5+ player races)'. No rule specifies which count applies after cars finish.
